definitions.gloss: pre-order bonus; reservation perk; booking privilege
definitions.explanation: A special bonus item or benefit given to customers who reserve or pre-order a product. Common in the gaming, entertainment, and retail industries.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: You can get a poster as a pre-order bonus.

examples.japanese: {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦{目当|めあ}て→目当て：13648_meate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered early because I wanted the pre-order bonus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: The pre-order bonuses differ by store, so I'm having trouble deciding where to buy.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in gaming, anime, and entertainment retail. Different stores often offer different {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん} for the same product, which is a deliberate marketing strategy. Can include physical items (figures, art books), digital content (bonus stages, skins), or early access.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (a pre-order bonus is included)
- {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (with pre-order bonus)
- ⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧{予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん} (store-specific pre-order bonus)
- {予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ (contents of the pre-order bonus)
